_comment: 20 monitored firms. Adapters: greenhouse | lever | workday | eightfold | json_api | html_links (see scripts/fetch_jobs.py docstring). Every firm has a scripted adapter — the pipeline is fully standalone. html_links is a server-rendered-HTML fallback; JS-heavy sites will show up as EMPTY in --verify, in which case find the site's underlying JSON endpoint (browser dev tools → XHR) and switch the entry to json_api/eightfold per references/SETUP.md. Tokens marked verified:false are best-guess; --verify and fix, then set true.
